Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: data assurance docs + invoicing details

Hi Samantha — welcome, and thanks for sending those over. A few procurement-driven next steps from our side so we can create a vendor record and issue a PO: 

1) Complete our Vendor Setup Form (secure link below) with remit address + contact for invoices.
   - Form: https://redwood-inference.com/proc/vendor-setup-form?id=TEMP
2) Execute Redwood's DPA (we require signature from the vendor). I've attached a DocuSign envelope for our standard DPA; please sign the one labeled "Redwood DPA for Linewave" so our legal and security teams have the executed copy on record.
   - DocuSign (Redwood envelope): https://app.docusign.com/LinkToSigner?token=EXAMPLE-DS-67890
3) Confirm SOC 2 scope: we need either a hosted report (public link) or an SSAE attestation PDF. The link you sent is fine, but Security may ask for a short attestation paragraph confirming the report covers production systems used for the service you will provide to Redwood.
4) W-9 is required to issue a vendor code in our system — thank you for attaching it.
5) Once we receive the completed form + signed Redwood DPA + W-9 we will provision a temporary vendor code and create the PO. Expect the vendor code within 24 business hours after documents are complete.

For PO terms: our standard is Net30. If you require Net45 or other terms, please flag this now and include a business justification; Marissa (cc'd, procurement) will route for approval.

If you prefer a quick call to review the form fields, I can jump on Thursday afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Setup_Form_link.txt, text/plain)
